features.title: [Feature][backend]Define supported activity source and file disposition
features.statement: Define the supported FIT source boundary and classify submitted files with explicit outcomes under an approved source contract.
acceptance_criteria: Given a file and approved versioned source contract, supported/rejected cases have explicit reasons; oracle: each matrix row cites evidence or remains unresolved.
outputs: Versioned FIT support matrix and per-file disposition contract
features.notes: Proposal; mappings, limits and fixture terms are not approved.

features.title: [Feature][database]Preserve original uploads and conflict-aware history
features.statement: Preserve accepted source bytes and provenance while handling repeated uploads and logical conflicts without silent overwrite.
acceptance_criteria: Given accepted and repeated/conflicting imports, bytes remain identifiable, normalized records link to source, duplicates do not create new history, and conflicts surface; oracle: TC02/TC03 under approved policy.
features.notes: Proposal; conflict tolerance and lifecycle policy remain open.

features.title: [Feature][backend]Prepare activity data deterministically
features.statement: Normalize supported activity data reproducibly using conventional processing without inference.
acceptance_criteria: Given identical source/configuration/version, normalized output is semantically identical and no inference occurs; oracle: TC04.
features.notes: Proposal; input contract and baseline skill fields await D01/D02.

features.title: [Feature][backend]Package scoped skill inputs with provenance
features.statement: Package only selected, provenance-linked prepared data required by a skill in a versioned envelope.
acceptance_criteria: Given a selected scope and declared skill inputs, envelope values are versioned, traceable and free of credentials/out-of-scope records; oracle: TC05/20/23.
outputs: Versioned scoped skill-input envelope and provenance presentation
features.notes: Proposal; exact baseline skill fields await D02.

system_requirements.title: [SR][frontend]Present file disposition with textual reason
system_requirements.statement: For each submitted file, the system shall present its accepted or rejected disposition as text associated with that file and include the applicable approved rejection reason.
acceptance_criteria: Given each approved accepted/rejected fixture, the interface identifies file and textual disposition; oracle: rendered result matches TC21 and is understandable without color/icon alone.
Given a rejected fixture, displayed reason matches the approved contract reason; oracle: compare displayed reason/code to the approved matrix.

system_requirements.title: [SR][frontend]Distinguish duplicate imports and unresolved conflicts
system_requirements.statement: The history view shall distinguish persisted activities, exact duplicate imports, and unresolved conflicts according to the approved persistence contract.
acceptance_criteria: Given identical bytes are imported twice, history does not show a second activity and identifies the duplicate import reference; oracle: TC22 agrees with persisted activity count.
Given an approved conflict fixture, history identifies affected records and unresolved status without implying merge or overwrite; oracle: TC22 matches the approved conflict policy.

system_requirements.title: [SR][frontend]Label prepared data scope and provenance
system_requirements.statement: Readiness presentation shall label selected data scope, source observations, computed metrics, and quality warnings according to their contract provenance.
acceptance_criteria: Given a prepared fixture, interface displays scope and distinguishes observations, computed metrics and warnings; oracle: displayed labels and values map to prepared provenance in TC23.
Given an absent optional value, presentation identifies it as unavailable/unknown and does not render zero or infer a value; oracle: TC23 negative fixture.

tasks.title: [Task][legal]Inventory FIT source and fixture terms
acceptance_criteria: For each candidate official reference/fixture, provenance and terms or unresolved rights questions are recorded; oracle: every source has a provenance row or explicit gap and no legal conclusion is invented.
outputs: Evidence-indexed FIT source and fixture provenance inventory

tasks.title: [Task][architecture]Draft FIT support and mapping matrix
acceptance_criteria: Each proposed FIT variant, record, mapping, unit, timestamp, integrity and rejection rule cites official evidence or remains explicitly unsupported/unresolved; oracle: traceable matrix, with no guessed mapping or numeric limit.

tasks.title: [Task][backend]Implement approved file classification and diagnostics
acceptance_criteria: Given an approved-matrix fixture, classification and textual per-file outcome match its expected disposition/reason; oracle: unsupported/malformed cases reject and approved accepted cases import without silent fallback.
outputs: Implemented contract-versioned classification and accessible per-file diagnostics

tasks.title: [Task][management]Verify FIT classification and file disposition
acceptance_criteria: On the fixed candidate, execute supported, malformed, unsupported and missing-field fixtures; oracle: dispositions/reasons match the approved matrix and rendered text identifies file/outcome; record actual environment, result and limits.

tasks.title: [Task][security]Assess FIT intake data flow and operational gaps
acceptance_criteria: Map source bytes, identifiers and diagnostics across intake; identify access, logging and recovery questions; oracle: each concern links an existing SR or explicit evidence gap, without assuming security controls or service targets.
outputs: FIT intake data-flow and operations gap report

tasks.title: [Task][architecture]Compare duplicate and conflict policy options
acceptance_criteria: Compare only exact-byte, documented-tolerance and no-logical-detection options from WP01; oracle: each describes observable duplicate/conflict outcomes and leaves D01 choice to founder.

tasks.title: [Task][database]Implement immutable originals and duplicate-safe history
acceptance_criteria: Given the approved storage/identity contract, accepted bytes retain an integrity identifier and normalized records link to source; identical re-import is idempotent and a conflict is never silently overwritten; oracle: TC02/03/22.
outputs: Immutable source lineage and duplicate/conflict-safe history behavior

tasks.title: [Task][management]Verify original preservation and history behavior
acceptance_criteria: On the fixed candidate, reload originals, re-import identical bytes and submit approved conflict fixtures; oracle: integrity/source links resolve, duplicate count is unchanged, conflict remains visible, and actual results/limits are recorded.

tasks.title: [Task][management]Investigate history rights and lifecycle policy gaps
acceptance_criteria: Record sourced rights, retention, backup/recovery and privacy questions for retained and prepared user data; oracle: each issue has a source or explicit unknown/owner question; no legal duty, duration, RPO or RTO is invented.

tasks.title: [Task][backend]Implement deterministic model-free normalization
acceptance_criteria: Given approved source/configuration/version, repeat preparation produces semantically identical normalized output and no inference request; oracle: TC04.

tasks.title: [Task][management]Verify deterministic normalization
acceptance_criteria: On the fixed candidate, repeat preparation with inference disabled; oracle: semantic output matches excluding permitted IDs/timestamps and observed inference calls equal zero; record actual environment/results.

tasks.title: [Task][runtime]Assess preprocessing runtime and operations gaps
acceptance_criteria: Identify source-backed resource dimensions and run-version/configuration diagnostics needed to interpret repeat preparation; oracle: proposed bounds cite evidence or remain open, and no service target is fabricated.
outputs: Preprocessing resource and reproducibility operations gap report

tasks.title: [Task][backend]Implement versioned scoped skill input and provenance display
acceptance_criteria: Given approved input contract, package only selected declared inputs with snapshot/source or calculation lineage and display scope/value classes; oracle: TC05/20/23, including out-of-scope/secret and absent-value negatives.
outputs: Scoped versioned skill-input envelope and provenance/readiness display

tasks.title: [Task][management]Verify scoped input provenance and readiness
acceptance_criteria: On the fixed candidate, inspect narrow scope, envelope and rendered labels; oracle: included values are declared/in-scope with resolvable lineage, absent optional data is not zero, and negative secret/out-of-scope examples reject; record actual evidence.

subtasks.title: [Task][legal]Identify official FIT source references
subtasks.statement: Locate candidate official FIT protocol/profile references and record their source/version labels.
acceptance_criteria: Reference inventory contains a location and version for each candidate reference or labels it unknown; oracle: each matrix row is traceable to source metadata.

subtasks.title: [Task][legal]Record fixture provenance and terms
subtasks.statement: Inventory proposed fixture origin and usage terms without copying material whose terms are unresolved.
acceptance_criteria: Every candidate fixture has a provenance/terms row or explicit unknown and owner question; oracle: TC24 inspection list contains no unsupported rights conclusion.
outputs: Fixture provenance and open terms table

subtasks.title: [Task][architecture]Map records and fields to evidence
subtasks.statement: Compare candidate record/field coverage with official FIT profile evidence and identify unsupported entries.
acceptance_criteria: Each proposed record/field mapping cites evidence or is marked unresolved/unsupported; oracle: matrix rows satisfy TC19 traceability.

subtasks.title: [Task][architecture]Document timestamp unit null and integrity rules
subtasks.statement: Record source-supported timestamp, unit conversion, null and integrity behavior and leave unsupported values open.
acceptance_criteria: Rule table cites evidence for every specified behavior and flags unresolved choices; oracle: no unmapped value is silently assigned a conversion or fallback.

subtasks.title: [Task][backend]Implement source-matrix classification
subtasks.statement: Implement deterministic accepted/rejected classification from the approved source matrix and contract version.
acceptance_criteria: For each approved fixture, classification equals the expected matrix result; oracle: TC01/TC19 accepted cases succeed and unsupported/malformed cases reject.

subtasks.title: [Task][frontend]Render textual file status and reason
subtasks.statement: Render each file result with file identity, textual disposition and approved rejection reason.
acceptance_criteria: Rendered accepted/rejected fixtures identify file, status and reason without color-only meaning; oracle: TC21.

subtasks.title: [Task][management]Run source conformance fixtures
subtasks.statement: Execute approved supported, malformed, unsupported and missing-field fixtures against fixed candidate.
acceptance_criteria: Record actual result and target commit per fixture; oracle: outcomes/reasons match approved matrix or a reproducible defect is logged.

subtasks.title: [Task][management]Inspect rendered file disposition
subtasks.statement: Inspect file-linked text and rejection reasons for approved fixtures in the fixed rendered UI.
acceptance_criteria: Record actual rendered result/viewport and any failure; oracle: file/outcome/reason are identifiable without color/icon alone per TC21.

subtasks.title: [Task][security]Trace source bytes and metadata through intake
subtasks.statement: List source data, identifiers and diagnostics crossing the FIT intake boundary.
acceptance_criteria: Each identified data item has purpose and CUS/SR trace or explicit open question; oracle: data-flow inventory is reviewable and makes no unsupported control claim.

subtasks.title: [Task][operations]Map intake failure recovery questions
subtasks.statement: Record operational questions for decoder rejection/failure, diagnostics and recovery.
acceptance_criteria: Every failure category has a reason/recovery note or an explicit gap owner; oracle: no unapproved service target or numeric limit is stated.

subtasks.title: [Task][architecture]Trace exact-byte duplicate behavior
subtasks.statement: Map same-user same-byte re-import behavior to SR04 and the planned duplicate fixture.
acceptance_criteria: Exact-byte case points to current SR04 and TC03; oracle: no logical identity or tolerance policy is added by this trace.

subtasks.title: [Task][architecture]Compare unresolved logical conflict examples
subtasks.statement: List different-byte candidate records whose logical identity outcome depends on D01.
acceptance_criteria: Each example states competing outcomes and remains unresolved; oracle: no tolerance threshold is encoded before founder D01 decision.

subtasks.title: [Task][database]Persist original bytes with integrity reference
subtasks.statement: Implement approved original-byte retention and integrity identifier without selecting a stack outside D05.
acceptance_criteria: Reloaded original bytes match the submitted digest and each normalized record resolves to source; oracle: TC02.

subtasks.title: [Task][database]Implement approved duplicate and conflict disposition
subtasks.statement: Apply the approved same-byte duplicate and logical conflict policies without overwrite or unapproved merge.
acceptance_criteria: Repeated identical bytes create no additional activity and an approved conflict is surfaced unresolved; oracle: TC03/TC22.
outputs: Duplicate-safe history and visible conflict behavior

subtasks.title: [Task][management]Verify original integrity and lineage
subtasks.statement: Reload original files and resolve normalized records to their stored source on fixed candidate.
acceptance_criteria: Actual digest and source-link outcomes are recorded for fixtures; oracle: bytes and lineage match TC02 or a defect is logged.

subtasks.title: [Task][management]Verify duplicate and conflict history states
subtasks.statement: Repeat identical imports and exercise approved logical-conflict fixtures against rendered history.
acceptance_criteria: Record actual state/count and candidate/viewport; oracle: duplicate is not counted twice and conflict remains textually unresolved per TC03/TC22.

subtasks.title: [Task][legal]Separate source terms from user data questions
subtasks.statement: Identify source-term questions for the official specification, uploaded files and derived records, without deciding legal rights.
acceptance_criteria: Each data class has a cited term or explicit unknown and owner question; oracle: TC24 has no fabricated legal conclusion.

subtasks.title: [Task][operations]List history retention backup and privacy gaps
subtasks.statement: Document open retention, access/privacy, backup and recovery choices for persistent source and prepared data.
acceptance_criteria: Each missing lifecycle policy is an explicit sourced or owner-assigned gap; oracle: TC26 identifies questions without duration, duty, RPO or RTO assumptions.

subtasks.title: [Task][backend]Implement deterministic model-free normalization
subtasks.statement: Implement approved normalization with conventional deterministic processing and no inference calls.
acceptance_criteria: Given approved source rules, normalizer emits expected values; oracle: independent fixture values match TC04.

subtasks.title: [Task][backend]Implement scoped versioned input and provenance presentation
subtasks.statement: Package declared selected-scope inputs with snapshot/source or calculation lineage, exclude credentials/out-of-scope records, and show provenance labels.
acceptance_criteria: Valid scoped envelope citations resolve, and missing optional values are labeled unavailable/unknown; oracle: TC05/20/23 and negative cases reject credentials/out-of-scope values.
outputs: Versioned scoped skill-input envelope and provenance labels

subtasks.title: [Task][management]Verify repeat preparation and model isolation
subtasks.statement: Run the same approved source/configuration twice while inference access is disabled and record actual candidate results.
acceptance_criteria: Target commit/environment and repeat outputs are recorded; oracle: semantic values match under TC04.

subtasks.title: [Task][management]Verify scope provenance and readiness labels
subtasks.statement: Inspect a narrow prepared-data envelope and rendered readiness state with missing optional values and warnings.
acceptance_criteria: Target commit/viewport and actual displayed and packaged fields are recorded; oracle: all fields are in selected declared scope with resolvable lineage and missing optional data is not shown as zero per TC05/20/23.

subtasks.title: [Task][runtime]List preprocessing resource dimensions
subtasks.statement: Identify file/record/compute dimensions relevant to deterministic preprocessing and their measurement method.
acceptance_criteria: Each candidate dimension has a measurement method and source or an explicit evidence gap; oracle: no unsupported limit is stated in TC25/TC27.

subtasks.title: [Task][operations]Specify repeat-run diagnostic fields
subtasks.statement: List source, configuration and version fields needed to interpret preparation results and failures.
acceptance_criteria: Repeat-run record identifies source/configuration/preprocessing version or flags the missing field; oracle: TC27 can establish whether two runs are comparable.

subtasks.title: [Task][backend]Execute preprocessing with model access disabled
subtasks.statement: Ensure ingestion/preparation path completes without creating or calling an inference adapter.
acceptance_criteria: Preparation succeeds with model access disabled and observable inference call count is zero; oracle: TC04.

subtasks.title: [Task][management]Record repeat-preparation outcomes
subtasks.statement: Execute two runs with fixed source/configuration/version and compare semantic output fields.
acceptance_criteria: Target commit/environment and both outputs are recorded; oracle: equality excludes only approved generated IDs and processing timestamps per TC04.

subtasks.title: [Task][backend]Implement versioned scoped input envelope
subtasks.statement: Bind input envelope to snapshot/scope and include only skill-declared records, context and provenance.
acceptance_criteria: Envelope validates selected snapshot/scope and each computed metric has source/calculation lineage; oracle: TC05/20, with credentials/out-of-scope negative cases rejected.

subtasks.title: [Task][management]Verify envelope scope and rendered provenance
subtasks.statement: Inspect prepared envelope and readiness display using a narrow known fixture with absent optional data.
acceptance_criteria: Candidate commit, viewport and field links are recorded; oracle: TC05/20/23 show only declared in-scope fields, resolvable evidence and unavailable rather than zero.

verification_cases.title: Accessible file disposition and rejection reason
verification_cases.expected: For every approved accepted/rejected fixture, result identifies file, textual disposition and approved reason; outcome is not conveyed by color or icon alone.

verification_cases.title: History duplicate and conflict presentation
verification_cases.expected: Repeated identical bytes do not appear as a second activity; approved conflicts identify affected records and remain unresolved without implying merge or overwrite.

verification_cases.title: Readiness scope and provenance presentation
verification_cases.expected: Selected scope and source/calculated/quality value classes match prepared fixture provenance; absent optional value is unavailable/unknown, never zero or inferred.

verification_cases.title: FIT source and fixture provenance inspection
verification_cases.expected: Official protocol/profile references and proposed fixture sources have provenance and terms recorded; unresolved rights questions are explicit and no unsupported legal conclusion is made.

verification_cases.title: FIT decoder resource-bound evidence inspection
verification_cases.expected: Candidate decoder resource dimensions and bounds cite authoritative evidence or remain unresolved; no numeric threshold is invented.

verification_cases.title: Persistent data lifecycle policy inspection
verification_cases.expected: Retention, privacy, backup and recovery choices are cited or remain explicit gaps; no duration, legal duty, RPO or RTO is fabricated.

verification_cases.title: Preprocessing runtime and reproducibility inspection
verification_cases.expected: Resource variables and run configuration/version needed to interpret repeated preparation are documented; unapproved limits remain open.

legal.rationale: FIT documentation and fixture terms have not been assessed; no rights or legal duty is inferred.

engineering.rationale: Acceptance/rejection and source field rules are explicit obligations.

runtime.rationale: Decoder resource bounds require evidence and decision; no threshold selected.

architecture.rationale: A versioned source matrix defines the import boundary.

privacy_security.rationale: Upload data flow/access questions need review; CUS10 requirements do not prove this path is implemented.

accessibility.rationale: Users need textual file outcome and approved rejection reason.

operations_backup_retention_recovery.rationale: Source failure diagnostics/recovery are not fully specified.

domain_provenance.rationale: FIT variants and field mappings require authoritative source evidence.

legal.rationale: Rights/retention implications for uploaded and derived data are not assessed; no duration or duty is inferred.

engineering.rationale: Original preservation, normalized source links, duplicate and conflict behavior are explicit obligations.

runtime.rationale: History growth/resource bounds and operating constraints are not selected.

architecture.rationale: Persistent source lineage and conflict lifecycle need a defined model.

privacy_security.rationale: Access and lifecycle impacts of retained source data require assessment.

accessibility.rationale: History needs distinct duplicate and unresolved-conflict states.

operations_backup_retention_recovery.rationale: Retention, backup, recovery and capacity policies remain open.

domain_provenance.rationale: Activity history retains links to original source bytes.

legal.rationale: Source/derived-data rights questions are not assessed; no legal duty is asserted.

engineering.rationale: Deterministic normalization, no inference, and scoped skill inputs are explicit obligations.

runtime.rationale: Preprocessing resource bounds and execution environment remain unmeasured/unselected.

architecture.rationale: Versioned canonical input packaging is proposed by SR28.

privacy_security.rationale: SR28 requires credential and out-of-scope data exclusion; a negative-case review is still planned.

accessibility.rationale: Readiness, selected scope, value class and missing data are user-facing.

operations_backup_retention_recovery.rationale: Repeatability diagnostics and recovery from preprocessing/packaging failures need assessment.

domain_provenance.rationale: Prepared metrics and observations need traceable source/calculation lineage.

notes: CUS01-CUS03 statements and priorities are referenced unchanged.
Existing SR01-SR07, SR27 and SR28 statements/statuses are unchanged; only feature/source/perspective link metadata is proposed.
Every P0 SR in this fragment is linked to both a bounded implementation Task and a bounded verification Task with STK leaves.
TC21-TC27 are planned cases, all Not run with empty evidence; no product verification is claimed.
Unresolved legal, runtime, privacy and operations perspectives have named investigation tasks; D01-D05 thresholds/decisions remain open.
